description: Source code for tree-walk functionality in a Git-like version control system, including functions for decoding, initializing, updating, and traversing tree objects, as well as handling symlinks and pathspec matching.

methods.name: decode_tree_entry
methods.description: Decodes a tree entry from a buffer into a tree_desc structure, validating format and extracting path, mode, and object ID.

methods.name: init_tree_desc_internal
methods.description: Initializes a tree_desc structure with given object ID and buffer, decoding the first entry.

methods.name: init_tree_desc
methods.description: Initializes a tree_desc structure with a tree object ID and buffer, aborting on error.

methods.name: init_tree_desc_gently
methods.description: Initializes a tree_desc structure with a tree object ID and buffer, reporting errors without aborting.

methods.name: fill_tree_descriptor
methods.description: Reads a tree object from the repository and initializes a tree_desc structure with its contents.

methods.name: entry_clear
methods.description: Clears a name_entry structure.

methods.name: entry_extract
methods.description: Extracts the current entry from a tree_desc into a name_entry.

methods.name: update_tree_entry_internal
methods.description: Updates a tree_desc's current entry, decoding the next entry in the buffer.

methods.name: update_tree_entry
methods.description: Updates a tree_desc's current entry, aborting on error.

methods.name: update_tree_entry_gently
methods.description: Updates a tree_desc's current entry, reporting errors without aborting.

methods.name: tree_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the current entry from a tree_desc into a name_entry.

methods.name: tree_entry_gently
methods.description: Retrieves the current entry from a tree_desc into a name_entry, with gentle error handling.

methods.name: trace2_traverse_trees_statistics_atexit
methods.description: Outputs JSON statistics about tree traversal counts and depths at program exit.

methods.name: setup_traverse_info
methods.description: Initializes traverse_info structure with base path and sets up tracing if enabled.

methods.name: make_traverse_path
methods.description: Constructs a traversal path string from traverse_info, appending a name component.

methods.name: strbuf_make_traverse_path
methods.description: Appends a traverse path to a strbuf based on traverse_info and a name component.

methods.name: extended_entry_extract
methods.description: Extracts the first relevant entry from a tree_desc, considering special matching rules.

methods.name: update_extended_entry
methods.description: Marks an extended tree_desc entry as processed or skips it.

methods.name: free_extended_entry
methods.description: Frees skip list nodes in an extended tree_desc.

methods.name: prune_traversal
methods.description: Determines whether to continue traversing based on pathspec and current interest.

methods.name: traverse_trees
methods.description: Recursively traverses multiple trees, applying a callback function, respecting depth limits and pathspec.

methods.name: find_tree_entry
methods.description: Finds a specific entry in a tree by name, returning object ID and mode.

methods.name: get_tree_entry
methods.description: Retrieves a tree entry object ID and mode by name from a tree object ID.

methods.name: get_tree_entry_follow_symlinks
methods.description: Follows symlinks in a tree to find a specific entry, handling external links and limits.

methods.name: match_entry
methods.description: Checks if a pathspec item matches a tree entry, considering wildcards and exclusions.

methods.name: tree_entry_interesting
methods.description: Determines if a tree entry is interesting based on pathspec matching rules.
